---
title: pss:baseline:host_ports
description: Ensures that containers do not bind ports directly on the host.
---

Ensures that containers do not bind ports directly on the host.

Allowed values:

- undefined/nil
- `0`

The rule checks the following fields:

- `spec.containers[*].ports[*].hostPort`
- `spec.initContainers[*].ports[*].hostPort`
- `spec.ephemeralContainers[*].ports[*].hostPort`
